general.title: General settings
general.description:
Update the UI-configured SmartIR entity and how many times every command is sent.

For MQTT and UFO-R11 (Moes/Tuya ZS06) IR blasters via Zigbee2MQTT, enter the `/set` topic such as `zigbee2mqtt/ufo_r11/set`. For Tuya blasters, enter a `remote.*` entity id or a JSON config. For Infrared, choose an existing Home Assistant `infrared.*` emitter entity. Native infrared receiver learning is not supported here yet.

data_description.passive_mode: Only transmit IR when you change a setting. Unchanged states are never re-sent, so the AC unit's own thermostat manages the temperature.
data_description.temperature_unit: Advanced. Declares the unit the codeset's own temperature keys are written in — it does NOT change how temperatures are displayed. For that, use Home Assistant's unit system or the entity's unit override. Leave on Auto unless a codeset is genuinely mislabelled; an override the codeset's range contradicts is ignored.
data_description.default_repeat_count: How many times each command is sent. A command with its own setting (Options → Repeat or learn one command) uses that instead. Repeating helps when the device sometimes misses a command; an AC beeps once per repeat.
data_description.default_repeat_delay_secs: Leave empty to use “Delay between commands”.

command.title: Pick a command
command.description: Pick the command to repeat or learn. Type to search, e.g. `cool / low / 24`. Commands marked [saved] have their own settings.

data_description.use_device_default: Untick to give this command its own count and delay below. A code learned for it is kept either way.
